learnings.question: What psychological phenomenon occurs when writing down or externally storing information signals the brain that it can safely forget it?
options: The Performance Paradox of Cognitive Offloading
learnings.learning: The 'Performance Paradox' of Cognitive Offloading describes how recording or storing information externally prompts the brain to treat the information as disposable and forget it.
learnings.articleTitle: Is Your Brain the Worst Place to Store Ideas? Why I Built a Second One

learnings.question: Which Scrum artifact is used to visualize the progress of a Sprint and display remaining work to determine if the team is on schedule?
learnings.learning: The Burndown Chart is a key Scrum artifact that visualizes a Sprint's progress, showing remaining work and helping track whether the team is on schedule.

learnings.question: Which concept or rule suggests that 80% of outcomes or results stem from 20% of efforts, often used to test whether learning a small core set of high-frequency words can unlock majority comprehension of a text?
learnings.learning: The study was motivated by the Pareto Principle (80/20 rule) to test whether learning the top 20 most frequent words could yield comprehension of 80% of the Quran.
learnings.articleTitle: Top 20 Words to Understand the Quran: A Data Analysis using Python

learnings.question: In Islamic belief, which term refers to the vital role of humans serving as caretakers or successive authorities on Earth?
learnings.learning: In Islamic teachings, life's purpose is defined by three primary responsibilities: worshiping Allah, living through a test of faith and conduct for the Hereafter, and serving as caretakers or stewards (khalifah) of the Earth.

learnings.question: What is the primary trade-off when a PCIe device transitions into progressively deeper power management states, moving from L0s toward L2?
options: Instantaneous resume capability with increased idle power draw
Greater energy savings at the cost of longer wake-up latency
Reduced energy efficiency in exchange for higher operating clock speeds
Higher data transmission bandwidth at the cost of increased heat generation
learnings.learning: PCIe power management relies on a spectrum of states (from L0 down to L2) that progressively power down device components, maximizing energy savings at the expense of longer wake-up times.
learnings.articleTitle: Power Management States in the context of PCIe
